sn51.20:1.1: cattāro me bhikkhave, iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
sn51.20:2.1: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā:
sn51.20:2.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti;
sn51.20:2.3: iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atipaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati
sn51.20:2.8: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:2.12: “iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atipaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati.
sn51.20:2.14: “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure,
sn51.20:2.15: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.20:2.16: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.”
sn51.20:2.17: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:4.2: yo hi bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto,
sn51.20:5.1: katamo ca bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto chando:
sn51.20:5.2: yo hi bhikkhave, chando thinamiddhasahagato thinamiddhasampayutto.
sn51.20:5.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhitto chando.
sn51.20:6.1: katamo ca bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando:
sn51.20:6.2: yo hi bhikkhave, chando bahiddhā pañca kāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhitto anuvisaṭo.
sn51.20:6.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhitto chando.
sn51.20:7.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpure saññī ca viharati:
sn51.20:7.2: “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure:
sn51.20:7.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pacchā pure saññā suggahitā hoti sumanasikatā sūpadhāritā suppaṭividdhā paññāya.
sn51.20:7.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchā pure saññī viharati:
sn51.20:7.5: “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure.”
sn51.20:8.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati:
sn51.20:8.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati:
sn51.20:8.3: “atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttanti.
sn51.20:8.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati.
sn51.20:9.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu “yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati:
sn51.20:9.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:9.3: yehi vā pana ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi rattiṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi divā chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:9.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati.
sn51.20:10.1: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti:
sn51.20:10.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ālokasaññā suggahitā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā.
sn51.20:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:13.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittaṃ viriyaṃ.
sn51.20:14.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, viriyaṃ bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittaṃ anuvisaṭaṃ. idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ viriyaṃ …pe…
sn51.20:18.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittaṃ cittaṃ.
sn51.20:19.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, cittaṃ bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittaṃ anuvisaṭaṃ.
sn51.20:19.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ …pe…
sn51.20:22.1: katamā ca bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittā vīmaṃsā:
sn51.20:22.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittā vīmaṃsā.
sn51.20:23.1: katamā ca bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā:
sn51.20:23.2: yā bhikkhave, vīmaṃsā bahiddhā pañcakāmaguṇe ārabbha anuvikkhittā anuvisaṭā.
sn51.20:23.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bahiddhā vikkhittā vīmaṃsā. katañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī viharati “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure:” idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pacchāpure saññā suggahitā hoti sumanasikatā sūpadhāritā suppaṭividdhā paññāya. evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī viharati. “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure.” kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho viharati: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati: “atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā …pe… lasikā muttanti.” evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā adho tathā addhaṃ yathā addhaṃ tathā adho viharatīti. kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu yehi ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi divā vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi rattiṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. yehi vā pana ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi rattiṃ vīmaṃsā samādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. so tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi nimittehi divā vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu yathā divā tathā rattiṃ tathā divā viharati. kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ālokasaññā suggahitā hoti divāsaññā svādhiṭṭhitā.
sn51.20:23.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.20:23.5: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
sn51.20:24.1: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti. “ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.”
sn51.20:24.2: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
